INT. RED HOWL PACK - HALL - DAY1 1

Arabella walks into the hall in a beautiful dress. Many guests there. Everyone smiles and salutes Arabella. GUESTSHappy birthday, my Luna! Arabella salutes them back. She walks to the stage in the hall - the stage curtain is behind her. Everyone is watching her. ARABELLAThank you all for coming to my birthday party... JESSICAAh, yes! Yes, baby! There is a sound of a woman MOANING interrupting Arabella's words. The guests falls silent and look at each other in shock, whispering. Arabella looks confused. She listens carefully and determines the sound is coming from behind the curtain. Arabella pulls the curtain open. JESSICA and DEREK, back naked, are having sex on a table - Jessica on top - under several tablecloths. When the curtain opens, they turn the heads in shock and immediately stop moving. The guests look at Arabella sympathetically. Arabella’s face shows the emotions of anger, shock, and humiliation. ARABELLAWhat the hell, Derek? How could you betray me? Even here, on my birthday, in front of everyone! Jessica gets off the table and walks to Arabella - a tablecloth is wrapped around her. JESSICAHappy birthday! Like this gift? By the way, you are not Luna anymore. Only I’m worthy of being Luna! Arabella looks at her in disbelief... then notices the necklace around Jessica’s neck.

ARABELLAThat's my necklace! Give it back! Arabella tries to take the necklace. But Derek - his waist wrapped in a tablecloth - grabs her hand stopping her, and looks at her coldly. DEREKStay away from her, Arabella. It’s your honor that Jessica wants your necklace. Show her some respect! She’s going to be your new Luna! ARABELLAHer? What about me? I should be your Luna. We’re mates chosen by the moon goddess. Derek releases Arabella's hand, pushes her away. DEREKStop talking about the moon goddess! She shouldn’t have chosen you, a weak wolfless rouge, as my mate. Jessica is a powerful gamma. You’ll never be better than her. Arabella tries to hold Derek’s hand. ARABELLABut we've been married for 3 years. DEREKIf you could shut up like a doll, maybe I would’ve considered letting you stay with me... as my slave. Now get out! Arabella cries as she runs through the crowd and out the door. Derek addresses the guests. DEREK(cont'd)It's okay, go on and enjoy the party, everyone.
EXT. FOREST - DAY2 2
Arabella runs in the forest, tears streaming down her face. ARABELLAThis is my birthday! How could they do this to me?

Suddenly a ROGUE WOLF appears and stops her. She is frightened and SCREAMS. ROGUE WOLFWhere are you going, beauty? Why don’t you go out with me? Arabella starts walking backward in fear. ARABELLAStay away from me! Rogue Wolf walks toward her, getting closer with each step. His expression becoming more and more evil. ROGUE WOLFYou have nowhere to hide. ARABELLAHelp! Suddenly there is a wolf runs towards the Rogue Wolf when the Rogue Wolf stretches out his hand to Arabella. A young and handsome guy appears and catches the rogue's hand and he knocks the Rogue Wolf down with a few punches. It’s EDWIN. Arabella looks at Edwin's handsome figure. The warm light shining from his side makes him look like a god descending from heaven. Edwin walks to Arabella and takes Arabella in his arms. He shows Arabella his charming smile - her face is radiating like the sun. EDWINYou OK?
EXT. FOREST - DAY3 3

Edwin is stilling holding Arabella. Arabella stares at his face then suddenly comes to her senses. ARABELLAI'm fine. Thank you, sir. Can you let me go now? Edwin gently puts her down on a big rock(or a park bench). EDWINNo offense, my apologies. Arabella, right? Happy birthday!

ARABELLADo you know me? Edwin shows her an emblem on his suit. EDWINI am Alpha Edwin, your father, Alpha Jackson's, adopted son. I am currently managing the Silver Moon pack on behalf of him. Arabella is surprised when she sees the emblem. ARABELLAI remember you now! So you are my brother? EDWINTechnically, yes. And I came here to take you home. Father finally agreed to let you go home to inherit Silver Moon pack. You won’t have to hide your identity anymore. Edwin notices that Arabella’s shoe fell off in the attack. ARABELLAI’ve been away for three years. That’s long enough. Edwin takes the shoes and gets down on one knee and puts it on her gently. EDWINYes, you have noble Alpha blood after all. Only you can lead a pack as powerful as the Silver Moon pack. Arabella can’t help looking at Edwin. Their eyes meet and then Arabella comes back to her senses. ARABELLATell my father I will be back. But first I need to go back to the Red Howl pack. EDWINUnderstood. Arabella stands and arranges her clothes.

ARABELLAThere's one last thing I need to finish, and that is to end it with Derek once and for all. As Arabella departs, Edwin's cell phone RINGS. He answers the call seriously. EDWINMax. Tell them I can't return yet to take over the Alpha King position. You must conceal my identity as the Alpha King successor.
INT. RED HOWL PACK - HALL - DAY4 4

As soon as Arabella walks in, The guests' sympathetic eyes are focusing on her. Derek is now dressed and comes over, throwing a file at her. DEREKSign it! Arabella picks up the document which says Divorce Agreement.
INT. RED HOWL PACK - HALL - DAY5 5

Arabella is holding the divorce agreement, then tosses it aside. ARABELLAFine! But we were married for three years. You at least own me an explanation... in front of everyone. Derek stares at Arabella with a cold expression. DEREKI told you. You don’t deserve to be in my pack, let alone be my mate or my Luna! At this time, a passage opens up in the crowd. Derek's mother LAURA and a dressed Jessica walk out. Laura looks at Arabella with disdain. LAURAThat's right. You have lowly blood, have no family and are very weak!

You are not worthy of being the Luna of the Red Howl pack. You should know your place! Upset, Arabella's voice trembles when she speaks. ARABELLAMom? You're on their side? That means you condone his cheating... Derek lets out a mocking LAUGH. He pulls Jessica into his arms. DEREKStop blaming everyone else. All of this is happening because of you. If you were half as interesting as Jessica is, I wouldn’t have strayed. Arabella looks at Derek and Jessica, almost burning with anger. Jessica walks over and whispers in Arabella's ear. JESSICAHow’s that feel, huh? Catching your husband cheating with a pregnant woman in front of everyone — pretty wild, right? ARABELLAWhat?! You're pregnant! Arabella looks Jessica’s belly in shock. Jessica pretends to fall and pulls Arabella down with her. There is a cry of fright from the crowd. Arabella hits the ground hard. Derek hurries to help Jessica up. JESSICAOw! She hurt me! DEREKAre you insane, Arabella? How could you do this to Jessica, especially when she's pregnant!? Arabella stands up, her face is pale. ARABELLADerek, I was so wrong about you. LAURAShut up and sign the divorce agreement right now! Otherwise I’ll make you suffer even more.

Arabella picks up the divorce papers and sneers. ARABELLAVery well, I've had enough of this! Arabella signs her name elegantly and throws it back to Derek. Arabella's pupils flash with silver light, and a shining werewolf family emblem appears in them. ARABELLA(cont'd)But remember this, Derek. I, Arabella Wellington, reject you, Derek Evans, as my mate. DEREKHow dare you do this to your Alpha? ARABELLAYou are not my Alpha, not anymore. Arabella turns to leave when Derek suddenly stops her. DEREKYou can't leave yet. Arabella turns and looks at Derek in anger. ARABELLAWhat else do you want from me? Derek looks at Arabella from head to toe and points at her. DEREKYou can't leave until you give back what's mine.
INT. RED HOWL PACK - HALL - DAY6 6

Arabella looks at them very angrily. Arabella takes off her earrings and necklace, and throws them on the ground. ARABELLAThis is your wedding present for me. Arabella takes off the bracelet and throws it to Derek. ARABELLA(cont'd)And the birthday present. DEREKGo on!

Arabella, visibly furious, pulls off her dress and kicks off her shoes. Some guests quickly avert their eyes in shock, while others continue to stare, wide-eyed and captivated by the scene. ARABELLAYou bought these for me, too. I’m not your wife from now on! Jessica sees the wedding ring on Arabella's hand and she points at Arabella's hand. JESSICAAnd that ring! Arabella is now in her underwear. She turns back to Derek with a blank expression, a single tear escaping down her cheek. Glancing at her hand, she grips the ring tightly before yanking it off and hurling it at him. The ring bounces off Derek and clatters to the floor. ARABELLASatisfied? DEREKYou can leave. ARABELLAMarrying you is my biggest regret!(turns to Jessica)And you, Jessica, you must really like picking up my trash. But whatever suits you. The onlookers make way for Arabella as she walks through the crowd and steps out of the Red Howl pack.
EXT. STREET OUTSIDE OF THE RED HOWL PACK - DAY7 7
location: EXT STREET OUTSIDE OF THE RED HOWL PACK

text: As Arabella walks down the street, 3 luxury cars stop in front of her. Edwin gets out of one car and walks over to Arabella. EDWINWhat happened? Edwin takes off his coat and puts it around Arabella, and holds her. ARABELLAPlease take me Home.
Suddenly, a magical light emits from their bodies while hugging. Edwin and Arabella are both shocked. EDWINYou are my mate?
EXT. STREET OUTSIDE OF THE RED HOWL PACK - DAY8 8
location: EXT STREET OUTSIDE OF THE RED HOWL PACK

text: Arabella carefully touches Edwin’s chest. The two of them emit a magical light. EDWINYou and I are destined to be together, Arabella. We’re fated mates. ARABELLAThis is insane! You’re my stepbrother - it can’t be. We must keep this hidden. Edwin looks at her deeply. EDWINI’ll keep it quiet. But Arabella, the universe has a plan.
INT. SILVER MOON PACK - LUXURIOUS LIVING ROOM - DAY9 9
location: INT SILVER MOON PACK - LUXURIOUS LIVING ROOM

text: JACKSON (Arabella's dad) sits at the table, surrounded by 2 SERVANTS. 4 BODYGUARDS appear and Jackson looks at them expectantly. The Bodyguard steps aside as Edwin and Arabella come out. Arabella walks in front. Although she is only wearing a slip and a coat, she appears confident. Jackson LAUGHS and stretches out his arms. JACKSONArabella, my dear! You are finally home! Happy birthday, my baby girl! Arabella immediately runs to Jackson and hugs him. ARABELLAOh, Dad! I missed you so much! Arabella LAUGHS happily but sheds tears at the same time.

ARABELLA(cont'd)I’m sorry, Dad! I should not have been away from my family. JACKSONCome on, kid, don’t be. You're all I care about. It’s good to see that you are safe. Jackson, Arabella, and Edwin all sit down. Jackson looks at Arabella's clothes. JACKSON(cont'd)Now tell me what happened? ARABELLADerek betrayed me. He had an affair in front of me, then he forced me to divorce him and kicked me out. Jackson becomes very angry and stands. JACKSONWhere is this scumbag? I’ll make him pay for this! Arabella stops Jackson and touches his arm. ARABELLADad, please. What’s done is done. Let it go. JACKSONHow dare he do this to my beloved daughter? His entire pack cannot even hold a candle to you. EDWINI’ll teach them a lesson. It’s a lucky thing that Arabella is no longer with the wrong person. Jackson smiles. He sits down and pats Arabella’s hand. JACKSONThat’s right! It’s good you divorced him. You’ll meet a handsome second mate. Edwin and Arabella glance at each other. Edwin interrupts Jackson immediately.

EDWINFather, let's talk about the gift we prepared for Arabella. JACKSONIndeed! Arabella, I’m going to hand the Silver Moon Pack over to you. Edwin takes out a black card and gives it to Arabella. EDWINThis is a top-tier black card — only four exist globally, and this one shows you're the boss in the Silver Moon Pack. Arabella takes the black card and she looks at it. ARABELLAYou’re spoiling me! Jackson CHUCKLES. He grabs a file on the desk and hands it to Arabella. She takes it and reads it with hesitation. JACKSONAnd this is a list of the strongest soldiers in our pack. They’ll support you when you feel ready to become the Alpha. Of course, they’re all good mate material. You can choose any of them. Jackson winks. Arabella realizes his meaning and quickly looks at Edwin, who seems tense.
INT. SILVER MOON PACK - ARABELLA’S BEDROOM - DAY10 10
location: INT SILVER MOON PACK - ARABELLA’S BEDROOM

text: Arabella is sitting in the armchair, reading the file Jackson gave her. Edwin walks to her. EDWINSo, working through lunch now, huh? You’re really interested in those soldiers. Arabella keeps reading, without looking up. ARABELLAUh-huh, they’re not bad.

Edwin spins Arabella's chair so she faces him. He corners her and slams his hands on the armrests. EDWINIf you’re want to be married again, why not choose me? I’m much more handsome and powerful than those soldiers. And I’m your second mate, chosen by the moon goddess. ARABELLAThat all sounds good, but- Edwin gently brushes Arabella's hair away from her face and behind her ears. ARABELLA(cont'd)Maybe we should wait, until we’re both ready. EDWINI see. It's okay, don't pressure yourself. Edwin and Arabella look at each other, and the two of them move closer and closer. EDWIN(cont'd)But I want you to know that I do have feelings for you. I can't help feeling drawn to you... ARABELLAAnd I, you. They kiss passionately. Edwin holds Arabella's head with one hand and caresses her with the other hand. Arabella unbuttons his clothes. A sudden KNOCK at the door. They immediately stop what they're doing. ARABELLA(cont'd)Who's there? JACKSONIt's me, sweetheart. I'm coming in. Arabella and Edwin are very nervous. ARABELLA(whispering)We can't let Dad find out about our relationship. Hide! Hurry!

Arabella pulls Edwin into the cloakroom. At this time, the bedroom door also opens. INT. SILVER MOON PACK - ARABELLA'S CLOAKROOM - DAY 10A 10A Arabella and Edwin hide in the cloakroom, watching Jackson through a gap in the door. Edwin accidentally KNOCKS OVER a clothes hanger. Arabella covers Edwin's mouth and places her index finger over it. Jackson walks toward the cloakroom. JACKSONYou there, Arabella?
INT. SILVER MOON PACK - ARABELLA’S CLOAKROOM - DAY11 11
location: INT SILVER MOON PACK - ARABELLA’S CLOAKROOM

text: Arabella can see her father through a gap in the door. ARABELLA(pretend to be calm)Just changing my clothes. JACKSONIt's okay, I can wait. I just have something to tell you. Edwin leans against the wall, gazing at Arabella with affection. He gently removes her hand from his mouth and presses Arabella against the wall and kisses her neck. Arabella makes a gasping sound that she can't control. EDWIN(deliberately)Shh, you don’t want father to find out about us. Edwin immediately kisses her mouth heavily.
Outside the cloakroom, Jackson paces and checks his watch. JACKSONYou know what, I think I’m gonna go find Edwin.

Jackson takes out his cell phone and dials Edwin's number. INT. SILVER MOON PACK - ARABELLA’S CLOAKROOM - DAY11B 11B At this moment, a cell phone RINGS from inside the cloakroom. Arabella and Edwin look at each other in terror. Arabella suddenly opens the cloakroom door and leans halfway out to say hello. ARABELLAThat's my phone! Just another moment. Edwin immediately hangs up the phone.

character: INT. SILVER MOON PACK - ARABELLA’S BEDROOM11C 11C
text: Jackson puts down his phone and looks at her in confusion. JACKSONIsn’t that Edwin’s ringtone? Arabella smiles awkwardly and closes the door again. ARABELLAUm...maybe we happen to have the same ringtone. Yeah, that makes sense, right? Can you wait outside for me, Dad? I'll be right there! Jackson turns around and walks towards the door. JACKSONIt’s nothing important. I just want to remind you that I've prepared a party for you. It’s time to introduce you to all the packs. ARABELLAThanks, Dad! Love you! Jackson closes the door. Edwin finally comes out of the cloakroom. EDWINFather is really happy that you came back. Arabella walks into the cloakroom.

INT. SILVER MOON PACK - ARABELLA’S CLOAKROOM - DAY11D 11D ARABELLAIt seems he wants everyone to celebrate my return. Edwin looks back at Arabella and sees only the thrown clothes. The door of the cloakroom is half open, and Arabella's back is exposed while changing her clothes. Edwin immediately turns around.

character: INT. SILVER MOON PACK - ARABELLA’S BEDROOM - DAY11E 11E
text: Arabella comes out dressed and rubs Edwin's back. ARABELLAHow do I look? Edwin looks at her with amazement. EDWINStunning. But why did you change into sportswear? Arabella takes out the black card and flips it between her fingers. ARABELLAIt's time to see what this baby can do.
INT. THE SHOE STORE - DAY12 12

Arabella who wears simple casual wear, enters the store with Edwin. There are many exquisite SHOES displayed on the shelves. Arabella's eyes light up as she glances around, full of excitement. ARABELLAI’m so gonna max out this card. EDWINMax it out? You could buy the whole store and it wouldn’t even make a dent. Edwin smiles and goes to another section of the store. Arabella looks around and stops in front of the most beautiful pair of shoes.

ARABELLAThis pair is really awesome! Arabella touches the shoes, when a clerk comes over. CLERKIf you can’t buy it, you can't touch it. Arabella gets pissed and stands right in front of the shoes. ARABELLAExcuse me? That’s not how you treat a customer. And what makes you think I can’t afford them? CLERKThis pair of shoes is a limited edition worth $30,000. Someone like you? Please. You’d be lucky to afford a knockoff. Now, why don’t you go play dress-up somewhere else? Arabella’s face flushes with anger as the clerk tries to escort her out. Arabella stands her ground. ARABELLAI can’t believe this. You have no idea who I am! And you think you can just throw me out because of what I’m wearing? Snooty clerk rolls her eyes, about to respond when Edwin steps beside Arabella, placing a hand on her shoulder. Clerk's expression suddenly turns into horror. EDWINIs there a problem here? CLERKAlpha Edwin! I-I’m really sorry. I didn’t mean to offend you. Edwin throws a bank card to the clerk. EDWINWe’ll have it no matter how much it costs! Clerk immediately swipes his card and starts packing the shoes.

CLERKAlpha, buy anything you want. It’s an honor to serve you! EDWINGood! There’s something else I want you to do. Arabella and the clerk both look at him. EDWIN(cont'd)I want you to personally help the lady put on these shoes.
INT. THE SHOE STORE - DAY13 13

Clerk is embarrassed. CLERKThat’s not a part of my job. EDWINIt is now. Do as I say and help her put it on, or you'll lose more than just a sale. Clerk reluctantly takes a knee in front of Arabella and slips the shoes on her feet. CLERKYes, Alpha Edwin. Arabella looks at Edwin, who looks deep into her eyes. ARABELLAYou don't have to do this for me, Edwin. I can handle this myself. EDWINI want to protect you and won't allow anyone to bully. Plus, it’s the salesperson’s job to treat all customers with respect. Edwin’s phone suddenly RINGS and he stood up. EDWIN(cont'd)Our father again. I’ll pick you up later. Call me if you need anything.

Dewin leaves. Arabella gestures goodbye then admires the shoes on her feet. Jessica enters the store and immediately notices Arabella. JESSICAArabella? The ink hasn’t even dried on your divorce papers and you’re already rutting your way across town. Why are you here? Arabella's happy expression drops. ARABELLAAs you can see, I am buying what I need. JESSICAThe salesperson really shouldn’t let you in here, you tramp. I didn't think a country bumpkin like you is qualified to enter such a high-end store. ARABELLAA country bumpkin?! You know what, you’re the one who should leave. I could buy the whole store if I wanted to! JESSICAYou lowborn bitch! You have no right to enter high social circles. After all, you are just a weak Rogue Wolf without a pack. Arabella sneers disdainfully. ARABELLAWell, I'm going to the party at the Silver Moon Pack. I'm sure you know about it. JESSICADerek and I will also go to the party. And we'll stay at the most luxurious hotel - SPURIA Hotel, which only welcomes the highest elites. I'll be there to humiliate you. If you think you’re better than I, show me. ARABELLADeal! You're gonna regret this.
Jessica walks away. Arabella pulls out her phone. ARABELLA(cont'd)Hello, is this the SPURIA Hotel? I am the heiress of Silver Moon pack. I would like to book the presidential suite.
INT. SPURIA HOTEL - LOBBY - DAY14 14

In the hotel lobby, the hotel manager WILLIAM steps forward in front of 4 WAITERS. MANAGER WILLIAMEveryone, pay attention! The waiters gather together. MANAGER WILLIAM(cont'd)I just received a reservation. The heiress of the Silver Moon pack will stay in our hotel. She has booked the presidential suite. You must make sure she is taken care of and has a good time here! WAITERSYes, sir! MANAGER WILLIAMNow, get to work! William leaves, the waiters disperse and start doing their work. Waiter A and Waiter B stand at the hotel entrance. WAITER AThe Silver Moon pack is already the most powerful and richest pack. WAITER BThen this lady must be extraordinary. At this time Arabella walks into the hotel wearing simple casual wear. WAITER AThat’s obviously not her. Waiter A and Waiter B LAUGH. Arabella looks at them.

ARABELLAExcuse me? Are you guys judging me? WAITER AWhat if we are? WAITER BWe're expecting a very important guest soon. Go away! Arabella is angry and about to say something. At this time, Jessica, wearing gorgeous clothes, walks in. Waiter A and Waiter B become nervous. WAITER AThis lady must be the one! Waiter A and Waiter B bow toward Jessica. WAITER BGood afternoon, Miss! Arabella looks at them indignantly. ARABELLAWhat? Seriously?
INT. SPURIA HOTEL - LOBBY - DAY15 15

Arabella looks angrily at the two waiters. ARABELLAHow can you treat us differently like this? Jessica looks at Arabella proudly. JESSICAIsn't it obvious? Move over, Ms. Nobody. Waiter A walks to Jessica and bows again. WAITER AMiss, you are the one who booked the presidential suite, right? JESSICAThat's right, it's me!

ARABELLAWait, I booked it! Waiter B looks at her doubtfully, pushes her aside. WAITER BThat’s impossible. People like you can't afford even the cheapest room in the SPURIA hotel. ARABELLAYou ignorant snob! Jessica pretends to be impatient with these waiters. JESSICAThat's enough! Take me to the suite. Waiter A and Waiter B immediately lead the way. WAITER BThis way, please! Jessica walks by and looks at Arabella proudly. JESSICAI’ll make sure you lose, bitch! ARABELLAReally? We’ll see!
INT. SPURIA HOTEL - AT THE DOOR OF PRESIDENT SUITE - DAY16 16
location: INT SPURIA HOTEL - AT THE DOOR OF PRESIDENT SUITE

text: Waiters A and B walk Jessica to the door of the suite. WAITER AHere we are. JESSICAOkay, open the door. WAITER BMiss, only you can open it, with your VIP card. JESSICAWhat? Oh, of course. Jessica is very nervous and starts rummaging through her bag. WAITER AYou lost your VIP card, miss?
Arabella comes over and takes out her VIP card. ARABELLAYou mean this card?
INT. SPURIA HOTEL - AT THE DOOR OF PRESIDENT SUITE - DAY17 17
location: INT SPURIA HOTEL - AT THE DOOR OF PRESIDENT SUITE

text: Arabella walks to the door of the room holding the VIP card. ARABELLAOnly the VIP card can open the presidential suite, right? Waiter A and Waiter B are shocked. WAITER AThat's right. WAITER BBut how did you get the VIP card? Arabella swipes her card and the door to the room unlocks. ARABELLABecause I was the one who booked the presidential suite. Arabella turns the doorknob and is about to push the door open. ARABELLA(cont'd)Watch carefully! At this moment, Jessica suddenly grabs Arabella's hand and snatches the VIP card. JESSICAWait a minute! Arabella is surprised and the door fails to open. Jessica looks back at Waiter A and Waiter B. JESSICA(cont'd)This VIP card is mine! I lost it. She must have found it somewhere and just stole it! WAITER BThat's right, this VIP card is obviously not hers.

WAITER AWe believe you, Miss! Arabella looks at them very angrily. ARABELLAAre you two insane? She obviously just took the card from me! JESSICAKick this thief out, now! Waiter A and Waiter B immediately try to control Arabella. ARABELLALet me go! At this time, manager William appears. MANAGER WILLIAMStop!
INT. SPURIA HOTEL - AT THE DOOR OF PRESIDENT SUITE - DAY18 18
location: INT SPURIA HOTEL - AT THE DOOR OF PRESIDENT SUITE

text: Manager William walks towards the two waiters. MANAGER WILLIAMWhat are you doing? Waiter A and Waiter B are still holding Arabella tightly. WAITER AThis thief stole that lady’s VIP card. WAITER BWe are kicking her out. MANAGER WILLIAMWho told you to do this? Jessica walks up to the manager William. JESSICAI did. Do you have a problem? Manager William smiles and takes the VIP card from Jessica. He walks up to waiter A and waiter B and slaps them. MANAGER WILLIAMYou idiots!

Jessica, Waiter A and Waiter B are all very shocked. Manager William bows politely to Arabella and returns the VIP card to her with both hands. ARABELLAIt’s good that you recognize me, William. MANAGER WILLIAMI'm so sorry, miss. I'll fire them immediately! Manager William grabs the waiters’ collars and drags them away. Arabella takes the VIP and opens the door. ARABELLAYou lost this game. JESSICASo what? Arabella walks up to Jessica and looks at her intensely. ARABELLAI want you to admit your mistake and apologize to me in front of everyone!
INT. SPURIA HOTEL - AT THE DOOR OF PRESIDENT SUITE - DAY19 19
location: INT SPURIA HOTEL - AT THE DOOR OF PRESIDENT SUITE

text: JESSICAWhy should I do that?! ARABELLAYou cheated with my mate, took my Luna position, and now you accused me of stealing! JESSICAYou're such a baby! Nobody cares about the truth! There’s no way I’m gonna apologize to someone as lowborn as you! Arabella walks to Jessica directly, and Jessica stumbles backwards. ARABELLAHow can you be so shameless?

JESSICAFine. I’ll tell you the truth. I want to see you hurt. It is so much fun. Arabella raises her hand, intending to slap Jessica. Before she hits her, Jessica pretends to be hit and falls to the floor. Arabella looks at her hand in confusion. ARABELLAWhat are you doing? Then Derek rushes over. He pulls Arabella away and helps Jessica up. DEREKJessica, are you hurt? Jessica buries her head in Derek’s chest. JESSICAShe is trying to hurt me again! DEREK(angry)Arabella, how could you attack a pregnant woman? Why are you so vicious? ARABELLAWhat? I didn’t hit her! She fell on her own! DEREKShut up! I saw it! Are you saying she would risk her own child? Arabella is extremely angry. She sneers. ARABELLAShe's evil and you’re blind! You two clearly deserve each other! Arabella tries to leave but she is stopped by Derek. Jessica looks at Arabella with an evil smile. DEREKArabella, if you apologize now, I’ll forget this ever happened. Arabella breaks away from Derek's hand in disgust.

ARABELLAYou two are disgusting! I don't have time to waste on you. I have to get ready for the party. Arabella sneers and walks into the suite. Derek and Jessica scoff and leave. When the door opens again, Arabella appears in a gorgeous dress. Arabella's pupils flash with silver light, and the shining werewolf family emblem appears in her eyes. ARABELLA(cont'd)Those two will regret it the next time they see me!
INT. YACHT PARTY - DAY20 20

Derek, Jessica, and Laura walk into the party together. They look around. LAURAOh my goodness! This is so gorgeous! Jessica walks to the table and picks up a glass of wine. JESSICALook at the decorations, and the tableware! So luxurious and tasteful. LAURAThis is a party worthy of a powerful pack like the Silver Moon pack! Jessica hands Derek a glass of wine and holds his arm. JESSICAHoney, we have to befriend the leaders of Silver Moon pack! It will elevate our social status! DEREKI know. Don’t nag me! Behave yourself and don’t embarrass the Red Howl Pack. Jessica feels a little awkward and then she is interrupted by LAURA.

LAURAIs that Arabella? She looks radiant! Her dress must be expensive. JESSICA(jealous)The dust hasn’t even settled on her divorce and she already got herself a new beau! How else could a rogue wolf like her afford a dress like that?! Laura is irritated and walks to the front. LAURAWatch me. I’m gonna teach that bitch a lesson! Arabella is looking around, as if waiting for someone, when Laura approaches her. LAURA(cont'd)Well, well, well, look who’s here! I did not expect that a lowly werewolf like you would be shameless enough to come to such a grand event. Arabella looks at her with disgust. ARABELLAI have nothing to do with the Red Howl pack now!
